tool_args.rationale: Across rows, subtracting x_now leaves a response proportional to the signed step u_now−u_past, with its magnitude decreasing monotonically across the sampled horizons. Fit the amplitude and decay time numerically in the baseline-plus-exponential model; no additional probe is needed.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five varied-horizon and opposing-step observations identify a simple two-parameter exponential transient sufficiently; the observed residuals relative to x_now decay consistently with horizon.
The verified form predicts dependence on x_now alone and cannot explain the strong sign reversal with the direction of the u_now−u_past step.
A Maxwell-only output omits the evident persistent x_now baseline; including that baseline yields a consistent decaying step response.
Nuisance measurements are not relevant to resolving this signal and are explicitly disallowed by the task guidance.
